headlines.title: What To Expect From Western Digital’s (WDC) Q3 Earnings
headlines.summary: Leading data storage manufacturer Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC) will be reporting results this Thursday afternoon. Here’s what you need to know.

headlines.title: Cramer warns SanDisk and Western Digital are worst stocks if data center capacity shrinks
headlines.summary: Jim Cramer called out two storage giants sitting on massive year-to-date gains as the most dangerous stocks to own if one key spending trend reverses, and the math behind their profits makes the risk easy to underestimate.

headlines.title: Why Western Digital (WDC) Stock Is Up Today
headlines.summary: Shares of leading data storage manufacturer Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC) jumped 4.8% in the morning session after investors cautiously returned to beaten-down stocks following the previous week's technology retreat, helped by an analyst upgrade for Intel.

headlines.title: Sandisk, Datadog, Amazon Lead S&P 500 As AI Stocks Rebound
headlines.summary: Western Digital, Sandisk, Datadog, Twilio and Amazon led the S&P 500 index in Monday's stock market trading as artificial intelligence plays rebounded. Western Digital (WDC) gained 6.1% to 352.21 on Monday, still below all its key moving averages. Western Digital stock plunged 16.4% last week.

headlines.title: 80% Upside? Why Morgan Stanley Is Pounding the Table on Battered Seagate and Western Digital Stocks
headlines.summary: Western Digital and Seagate Technology soon will be reporting earnings and Morgan Stanley says it would be aggressive buyers of each stock.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
